description: Tells every component inside it whether text runs left to right (ltr, e.g. Indonesian) or right to left (rtl, e.g. Arabic). Menus, sliders and carousels then flip their direction.
tip: Also set the dir attribute on <html> or a wrapper so the browser flips the layout too.

parts.provider: Passes the direction to every component inside it.
parts.hook: Reads the current direction in your own components.
